messages.subject: no tabs in source, please
parts:
Please don't use tabs in C++ source code.

We've gone with an "indent 2" standard for
C++ (mainly because it's the emacs default; I
was used to "indent 4" in Java).

The only files with tabs in them were

inv_wishart.hpp
multi_student_t.hpp
wishart.hpp

There's a simple emacs macro you can use to automatically
convert tabs to spaces on save.

(defun java-mode-untabify ()
(save-excursion
(goto-char (point-min))
(if (search-forward "t" nil t)
(untabify (1- (point)) (point-max))))
nil)

(add-hook 'java-mode-hook
'(lambda ()
(make-local-variable 'write-contents-hooks)
(add-hook 'write-contents-hooks 'java-mode-untabify)))

(add-hook 'html-mode-hook
'(lambda ()
(make-local-variable 'write-contents-hooks)
(add-hook 'write-contents-hooks 'java-mode-untabify)))

(setq indent-tabs-mode nil)

Of course, you need to add whichever cpp-mode you're
using.

- Bob
